mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates a weakening economy, which negatively impacts corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE rises by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate sales (HOUST) over three months signals a strengthening economy, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the periods with sustained increases in HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a reduction in supply, which negatively impacts corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where INDPRO declines by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it indicates inflationary pressure coupled with high borrowing costs, which negatively impacts corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3%, it signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and UNRATE declines > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real disposable personal income (RSAFS) over three months signals increased consumer spending, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the periods with sustained increases in RSAFS.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) increases by more than 1% in a month and GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 0.5% quarter-over-quarter, it signals a strong supply-side and overall economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increases > 1% in 1 month and GDPC1 grows > 0.5% QoQ
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.
